answer: Deposits are visible in haven, and mirror reconciles the forfeits at each close. A bond of 52% of expected earnings must sit in a custody account that the identity cannot spend from, only forfeit. Because the custody account is separate, anyone cannot recycle one pool of capital across 178 aliases, and each one needs its own funded jade account. A farm of 1484 identities would post 4049 proofs and burn roughly 11 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
